svg.title: FluxonFS S3 persisted PUT and read throughput overview
svg.desc: FluxonFS and Alluxio S3 Proxy persisted PUT, cold-read, and hot-read throughput across three object sizes and three concurrency levels.
svg.text: Persisted PUT, cold reads, and hot reads · rclone v1.60.1 · arithmetic mean of 3 runs
Upload timing includes target NVMe writeback and syncfs
Per group: cold F/A, then hot F/A; labels show FluxonFS vs. Alluxio
Each object-size panel has an independent y-axis; cold and hot reads share one y-axis within each read panel.
4 KiB uses objects/s; 1 MiB and 256 MiB use MiB/s. F/A delta = (FluxonFS / Alluxio − 1) × 100%; green leads, red trails.
See the accompanying article for persisted-write, cold-cache, and hot-cache conditions.
